_comment: Feature list for FEATURES.md (manual text). 'tables': 2_txt/pd2 or 2_txt/diff names (without extension) that belong to the feature; 'config': regex over ProjectDiablo.json key paths. Order = tie-break order for feature_rules.tsv.

features.name: loader
features.summary: How PD2 gets into the process: Storm.dll's renamed import loads PD2_EXT.dll (a version.dll proxy), PD2_EXT patches Game.exe and Fog.dll so the install path is the parent folder (where the vanilla MPQs live) and loads ProjectDiablo.dll after the MPQs open; D2Win.dll was edited on disk so its MPQ names point one folder up and D2Win_10086 loads ProjectDiablo.dll itself.

features.name: anti-cheat/integrity
features.summary: Hooks around the Warden client module of D2Client and PD2's own client checks. High level only: PD2 enumerates loaded modules and compares their names against a list of known third-party DLLs; the Warden hooks change how the client handles Warden requests.

features.name: save files
features.summary: Character save (.d2s) read/write in D2Game: PD2 widens the save buffers (0x2000 -> 0x20000 bytes), replaces the save/load paths with SaveFunctions.cpp code (S12 save columns of itemstatcost: 'Save Bits S12' etc.), and adds its own data to the file.

features.name: stash/shared stash
features.summary: Stash and shared-stash handling (extra stash pages, shared stash file).

features.name: loot filter
features.summary: Item display on the ground/in tooltips: BH.dll's Item module (PD2's loot filter) hooks D2Client item-name drawing; ProjectDiablo exposes the filter to BH (BHOnPropertyBuild etc.).

features.name: maps/map generation
features.summary: Endgame maps and level generation: DRLG/level-table hooks in D2Common/D2Game, map item stats (map_* in itemstatcost), corrupted zones (pGame->nCorruptedZone).

features.name: skills
features.summary: Skill behaviour on server (D2Game SKILLS/*) and client (D2Client SKILLS/*, skill bar, descriptions): new skill functions in the game's skill function tables (srvdofunc/cltdofunc, filled by the init-time table writes), changed skill calculations, buff timers / quick cast / skill bar UI.

features.name: items/crafting/cube
features.summary: Item generation, stats, properties, inventory and cube recipes: new cube outputs/functions (CubeFunctions.cpp), corruption, socketing, item stat callbacks, the bigger ItemStatCost record (PD2 indexes it with stride 0x150 = 336 bytes instead of 0x144 = 324).

features.name: UI/HUD/panels
features.summary: Client UI: panels, inventory screen, hover-item drawing, HUD texts (hp/mp text, belt status, dps), automap, the window procedure (keyboard/mouse/controller input), D2Win/D2Launch/D2Multi screens.

features.name: sound
features.summary: PD2's own sound engine (client/Sound/*.cpp: Sound, SoundChannel, SoundInstance, SoundSample) replaces the game's sound playback; per-category volumes.

features.name: networking/packets
features.summary: Client/server packet build and dispatch (D2Game PlrMsg/SCmd/sunitproxy, D2Client SCmd), D2Net, Battle.net client (Bnclient) and realm settings.

features.name: chat commands
features.summary: Chat input and PD2's slash commands.

features.name: monsters/AI/combat
features.summary: Monster AI (Ai/AiThink*), monster modes, damage (SUnitDmg), missiles, client unit drawing.

features.name: misc
features.summary: Patches no rule could place; see the per-hook notes.
